lines.text: One more plague is coming, then Pharaoh will drive Israel out, and Israel is to ask for silver and gold.
Moses says about midnight every firstborn son in Egypt will die, but not even a dog will snarl at Israel.
Each household picks a lamb, sharing with a neighbor if small, and keeps it until the fourth day.
The LORD tells them to put the lamb's blood on the doorframes, and He will pass over them.
Moses tells the elders to dip a cluster of cedar into the blood and brush it on the doorframe.
